facts.fact: All senior citizens aged 70 and above, irrespective of socio-economic status, get free treatment of up to Rs 5 lakh a year (family basis) under AB PM-JAY
facts.quote: to provide free treatment benefits of up to 5 lakh per year on a family basis to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of their socio-economic status on 29.10.2024.
facts.note: The same PIB release says Ayushman Vay Vandana cards are created for senior citizens aged 70 years and above.

facts.fact: To get the card, register at the nearest empanelled hospital, or self-register on the Ayushman app (Google Play) or www.beneficiary.nha.gov.in
facts.quote: They can visit nearest empanelled hospital for registration. For self-registration eligible citizens can download Ayushman app (from Google Play store) or visit www.beneficiary.nha.gov.in.

facts.fact: For help, call toll-free 14555 or give a missed call on 1800110770
facts.quote: Citizens can also call on the toll-free number 14555 or give a missed call on 1800110770 to know more about Ayushman Vay Vandana Card.

behaviour: pmjay.gov.in / beneficiary.nha.gov.in are not ingested: answers only from ingested pages (abdm/nhm/PIB) with citation, else says the source is not available and links the NHA site (beneficiary.nha.gov.in / nha.gov.in).
fail_if: It gives an income limit for the 70+ cover, invents steps or documents not on a cited official page, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added from PIB: 70+ cover of Rs 5 lakh/yr irrespective of income; register at an empanelled hospital or self-register via Ayushman app / beneficiary.nha.gov.in; helpline 14555, missed call 1800110770.
